description: This file contains shell functions related to platform-specific firmware upgrade operations for Linux-based embedded devices. It handles image partitioning, upgrade checks, and copying configuration data, mainly for system upgrades on Rockchip devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the new image's partition layout matches the existing one, and prompts for upgrade if it has changed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration file to the mounted partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade, writing the image to disk and handling partition updates.
